name: hunt_fv_cbreak15_ema1h_midpm

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (lens: structure breaks after the morning): the owner's 15-minute candle break -- a candle that closes beyond the previous candle's wick, entered with it -- in the midday and afternoon passes only, on the side of the 1-hour EMA 50, stop at the breaking candle's extreme, 1:1.5, once a pass. Why it should pay: after lunch the morning's balance breaks; a 15-minute close beyond the previous candle on the side of the hour-chart trend is the trend's buyers (or sellers) coming back with size, and it carries. Who loses: the midday range traders who sold the previous candle's high (or bought its low) expecting the lunch range to hold, and whose stops beyond it feed the break.

entry.words: On 15-minute candles, from 11:00: when a candle closes above the previous candle's high and above the 1-hour EMA 50, buy at the next bar's open; when it closes below the previous candle's low and below the EMA, sell. Stop at the breaking candle's extreme (its low for a long, its high for a short), target 1.5 x the stop. One trade in the midday pass (11:00-13:30) and one in the afternoon pass (13:30-15:58).

not_run: PARTLY SEEN: the candle_sweep family's break was read on its unseen months in the NY morning (owner_candle_break_15_nyam_nocap's pre-registered read and walk-forward, 2026-10-18/19). This sheet trades other hours (11:15-15:45 closes), so its trades are different, but the family and the months are the same: its walk-forward is not fully blind.

THE WICK: 'closes over the previous candle's wick' is read as a close strictly above the previous candle's high (long) or strictly below its low (short); the previous candle may be the last candle of the pass before.

THE 1-HOUR EMA: EMA(50) of the 1-hour closes (the last print of each whole ET hour that has ended), carried back across days to 150 closes, the contract's first day or 30 sessions; the signal close must be strictly above it (long) or below it (short); with fewer than 50 closes (right after a roll) there is no trade.
THE STOP: the breaking candle's extreme, measured from its close and placed from the fill at the next bar's open; floored at 0.25 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars.
THE CAP: one trade per session pass; two passes, so a day can hold up to 2 trades, and the midday trade may still be open when the afternoon pass enters.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no entry in the last 5 minutes of a pass.
